limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter wrap at five but also made ready_a high during reset and gated valid_b on sixth-bit acceptance, changing the original reset and terminal-count timing.

The test passed by requiring ready_a to stay high through reset and valid_b to stay low during a gap after five accepted bits, so it validated the rewrite rather than catching either timing regression.

limitations.quote: For a localized repair, check the existing output timing at reset release and during a gap at the terminal count
limitations.note: The agent read a note describing the same module and warning about both timing changes, but the warning did not affect the patch or the test expectations.
